components.name: Generate Button
components.description: Full-width primary action below the phrase controls.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: flex; width: 100%; min-height: 46px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 9px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; background: #51364f; color: #faf7fa; cursor: pointer; font: 650 13px system-ui, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease, opacity 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover:not(:disabled) { background: #624562; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, #715572 42%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { cursor: wait; opacity: .58; }

components.name: Copy Button
components.description: Outlined copy action paired with the generated phrase.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; min-height: 40px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; padding: 9px 12px; border: 1px solid #b9cfc1; border-radius: 8px; background: #f7faf6; color: #51364f; cursor: pointer; font: 650 12px system-ui, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease, transform 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(-1px); border-color: #91b09d; background: #fff; } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, #715572 42%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-btn-secondary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:disabled { cursor: not-allowed; opacity: .55; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Compact editable control used for advanced separator and number settings.
components.css: .ds-field { display: block; color: #463e4b; font: 650 13px system-ui, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; } .ds-field input { display: block; width: 100%; min-height: 38px; margin-top: 7px; padding: 0 10px; border: 1px solid #bdcfc3; border-radius: 7px; background: #f4f8f3; color: #393342; font: 14px ui-monospace, 'SFMono-Regular', Consolas, monospace; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, #715572 42%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Writing-System Tabs
components.description: Two-script switch with a distinct selected state.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 4px; } .ds-tab { display: inline-flex; min-height: 34px; align-items: center; gap: 7px; padding: 6px 10px; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 7px; background: transparent; color: #635a68; cursor: pointer; font: 500 13px system-ui, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; transition: background 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, border-color 150ms ease; } .ds-tab:hover { background: #e9f1eb; color: #51364f; } .ds-tab[aria-selected='true'] { border-color: #cfdfd3; background: #dcebe1; color: #3f5d4a; font-weight: 700; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid color-mix(in srgb, #715572 42%, transparent); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Word-Count Chip
components.description: Compact numeric context for the current phrase length.
components.css: .ds-chip { display: inline-block; padding: 6px 9px; border: 1px solid #cbded1; border-radius: 7px; background: #e8f1e9; color: #42624f; font: 650 11px system-ui, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Result Card
components.description: Paper work surface containing the generated phrase and actions.
components.css: .ds-card-result { min-width: 0; padding: 25px; border: 1px solid #c8d8ce; border-radius: 12px; background: #f5f8f4; color: #302438; } .ds-card-label { margin: 0; color: #6c5a6d; font: 750 11px system-ui, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; } .ds-phrase-box { display: flex; min-height: 142px; align-items: center; margin-top: 20px; padding: 22px; border: 1px solid #d3e1d8; border-radius: 10px; background: #edf5ef; } .ds-phrase-box p { min-width: 0; margin: 0; color: #3b293d; font: 600 27px/1.42 system-ui, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.025em; overflow-wrap: anywhere; } @media (max-width: 520px) { .ds-card-result { padding: 17px; } .ds-phrase-box { min-height: 126px; flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 9px; padding: 17px 13px; } .ds-phrase-box p { width: 100%; font-size: 23px; } }

components.name: Settings Panel
components.description: Lightly tinted container for phrase customization.
components.html:
Make it yours

Choose the shape of your phrase.
components.css: .ds-card-settings { min-width: 0; padding: 22px; border: 1px solid #c8d8ce; border-radius: 12px; background: #e2eee6; color: #302438; } .ds-card-settings h2 { margin: 0 0 5px; color: #3b293d; font: 650 18px system-ui, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.015em; } .ds-card-settings p { margin: 0; color: #625969; font: 400 12px system-ui, 'Noto Sans', sans-serif; } @media (max-width: 520px) { .ds-card-settings { padding: 17px; } }

narrative.overview:
Word by Word treats the generated Bulgarian phrase as the working material, not a teaser for a marketing page. A compact identity and appearance control give way to a brief purpose statement and a clear reading surface. Script choice, copy, and regeneration stay close to the result; customization sits beside it on wide screens and follows it on mobile.

Cool mint and muted green carry the light workspace, while plum gives the interface its identity and primary action. System UI typography supports Cyrillic and Latin text without an external font dependency. Depth comes from lightly tinted surfaces and fine rules, not card shadows. The same layout vocabulary shifts into a plum-dark theme through the manual or system appearance setting.
keyCharacteristics: Result-first, bilingual reading workspace with settings kept nearby.
Restrained plum, mint, and green selection colors across light and dark themes.
Quiet borders and tonal surfaces; rounded controls and readable phrase wrapping.

rules.name: The Plum-and-Mint Rule
rules.body: Use plum for identity and primary actions, and reserve green-tinted surfaces and text for selected or successful states; keep the same semantic distinction in dark mode.

rules.name: The Phrase-First Type Rule
rules.body: Keep the generated phrase visibly larger than controls and supporting copy; use the system sans stack for Bulgarian and Romanized readings rather than introducing a display face.

rules.name: The Result-Before-Settings Rule
rules.body: Keep the result first in the reading order; place settings beside it on wide screens and below it on narrow screens.

rules.name: The Tonal-Surface Rule
rules.body: Separate working regions with lightly tinted fills and fine borders; do not add ambient card shadows.

dos: Do keep the generated phrase and its Copy action together as the most prominent work surface.
Do retain the responsive composition: settings beside the result on desktop, below it on mobile.
Do use the existing system UI sans stack for both Bulgarian Cyrillic and Romanized text.
Do use fine borders and lightly tinted surfaces to distinguish result and settings regions.
Do preserve clear selected, focus-visible, disabled, success, and error states.
Do allow long phrases, tabs, and rules references to wrap within narrow viewports.
donts: Don't introduce a downloaded typeface or decorative display face into this system.
Don't use large ambient shadows to lift cards; depth is conveyed by surface tone and quiet rules.
Don't make Copy compete with the phrase or place settings before the result in the mobile flow.
